messages: It looks like #p201# is ready to return the #t4031064# she borrowed from #p218#.
I finally got my hands on the #t4031064# that #p218# asked for. Now, I just need to bring it back to her.

I delivered the materials needed to make the claw to #p218# in #m10001050# and received a scroll in return. I wonder if #p218#'s friend has already set out on their adventure by now. Who knows? Maybe I'll run into them during my travels!
name: Pia's Gift
